sql_calls.sql_query:
WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-03-27'::date,
    ('2025-03-29'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 709
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

sql_calls.sql_query:
WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-02-13'::date,
    ('2025-02-15'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 312
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

sql_calls.sql_query:
WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-03-27'::date,
    ('2025-03-29'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  JOIN rooms r ON r.room_number = ra.room_number
  WHERE ra.room_number = 709
    AND r.max_occupancy >= 2
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
    AND (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) > 0
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

  SELECT generate_series(

  LEFT JOIN room_availability ra
    ON ra.room_number = 1109
   AND ra.date = rd.date

eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.date, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 1109
    AND ra.status = 'Booked'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
updated AS (

  SET status = 'Available'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)

  )::date AS date
),
new_dates AS (

    '2025-02-03'::date,

    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
release_rows AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.date, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN old_dates od ON od.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 904
    AND ra.status = 'Booked'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
acquire_rows AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.date, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN new_dates nd ON nd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 1109
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM old_dates) AS release_needed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM release_rows) AS release_ok,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_dates) AS acquire_needed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acquire_rows) AS acquire_ok
),
released AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Available'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM release_rows)

),
acquired AS (

WITH old_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-03-22'::date,
    ('2025-03-24'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
new_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-02-13'::date,
    ('2025-02-15'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
release_rows AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.date
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN old_dates od ON od.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 904
    AND ra.status = 'Booked'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
acquire_rows AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.date, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN new_dates nd ON nd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 312
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.max_occupancy >= 2
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM old_dates) AS release_needed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM release_rows) AS release_ok,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_dates) AS acquire_needed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acquire_rows) AS acquire_ok
),
released AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Available'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM release_rows)
    AND (SELECT release_ok FROM counts) = (SELECT release_needed FROM counts)
    AND (SELECT acquire_ok FROM counts) = (SELECT acquire_needed FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date
),
acquired AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM acquire_rows)
    AND (SELECT release_ok FROM counts) = (SELECT release_needed FROM counts)
    AND (SELECT acquire_ok FROM counts) = (SELECT acquire_needed FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT release_needed FROM counts) AS old_nights_requested,
  (SELECT acquire_needed FROM counts) AS new_nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM released) AS old_nights_released,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acquired) AS new_nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM acquired) AS new_total_price
